gates.run: test -f Sonde.sln && dotnet build Sonde.sln -warnaserror --nologo -v q || { echo 'no solution yet: scaffold src/ first'; exit 0; }
test -f Sonde.sln && dotnet test Sonde.sln --no-build --nologo --filter 'Category!=EndToEnd' || { echo 'no solution yet'; exit 0; }
test -d tests/Sonde.EndToEnd && dotnet test tests/Sonde.EndToEnd --nologo || { echo 'no e2e suite yet'; exit 0; }
